# GitHub Copilot Instructions for CarboxMol Bioinformatics Club

See `PROJECT_AI_RULES.md` for full architectural mandates:
1. Universal Responsiveness: No component or header button may ever overflow horizontally on any screen size.
2. Bilingual Sync: Every new UI string must be translated in `js/i18n.js` with equal layout dimensions in AZ and EN.
3. Automated SEO: All route changes and language switches must update meta tags, hreflang, and JSON-LD structured data via `SeoResponsiveEngine`.
4. Portal Segregation: Students are members; mentors/faculty are teachers. Keep databases strictly distinct.
5. Synchronization: Keep both primary repo (`CarboxMol-Bioinformatics-Club.github.io`) and mirror repo (`CarboxMol-Bioinformatics-Club`) in exact parity.
